terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.subtitle: Last updated: 23 October 2026
terms.acceptanceBody: By accessing or using {site}, you agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, you may not use the service.
terms.useBody: You must be at least 13 years old to use Purana Bazaar. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials.
terms.accountBody: You may be required to register an account to post listings, send messages, or leave reviews. You agree to provide accurate and complete information.
terms.postingBody: You are solely responsible for the content of your listings. Listings must not be fraudulent, misleading, or prohibited. Purana Bazaar reserves the right to remove any listing at any time.
terms.paymentsBody: Listing boosts are optional paid features. Payments are processed through our payment partner. All payments are final and non-refundable except as required by law.
terms.moderationBody: Purana Bazaar may review listings, messages, reviews, and reports. Content may be removed or hidden without notice if it violates these Terms or applicable law.
terms.limitationBody: Purana Bazaar is provided "as is" without warranty of any kind. We are not liable for any disputes between users or for any loss arising from the use of the service.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms from time to time. Continued use of the service constitutes acceptance of the updated terms.
terms.contactBody: If you have questions about these Terms, please contact us through the app.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we collect, use, and protect your information.
privacy.infoWeCollectBody: We collect account information (name, email, phone), listing information, messages, and usage data to operate the service.
privacy.howWeUseBody: We use your information to provide the marketplace, facilitate transactions, send notifications, and improve the service.
privacy.sharingBody: We do not sell your personal information. Listing details and messages are visible to other users as part of the marketplace.
privacy.cookiesBody: We use cookies and similar technologies to remember your preferences and analyze traffic.
privacy.dataRetentionBody: We retain your data as long as your account is active. You may request account deletion at any time.
privacy.yourRightsBody: You may access, correct, or delete your personal information by contacting us or using the account deletion feature.
privacy.securityBody: We implement reasonable security measures to protect your information, but no internet transmission is completely secure.
privacy.contactBody: If you have privacy questions, please contact us through the app.
